props.title: Wise eyes on your ==writing==.
props.subtitle: A privacy-first English grammar checker — and your words stay yours.

slides.notes: Open with the promise: serious grammar checking that never phones home. Christie is the project behind CEO Owl.

props.title: Every keystroke, ==shipped to the cloud==.
props.body: Mainstream grammar checkers work by sending everything you type — drafts, emails, half-formed thoughts — to someone else's servers. Then you pay for the privilege with a subscription and your privacy.

slides.notes: Land the discomfort: the most intimate writing leaves the machine before it's finished. The subscription stings on top of the surveillance.

props.title: ==CEO Owl== — grammar checking that runs privately.

items.title: Built on Harper
items.body: The open-source Harper grammar engine does the serious linguistic heavy lifting.

items.title: In-browser editor
items.body: Write or paste text and it's checked on the spot, right where you're working.

items.title: Local by default
items.body: Analysis happens on your machine. Full stop.

slides.notes: CEO Owl is the product; Harper is the engine underneath. Emphasize that checking happens where the text is written — no upload step exists.

props.title: Run it locally and ==there is nothing to leak==.
